gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-vith: Funnel Display looks like thin steel rod bent into letters. Noto Serif Vithkuqi works the other way, with big round bowls and a slight pressure shadow like worn charcoal, so one is built to command and the other to be read.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-serif-yezi: No swelling mid-curve ever interrupts Funnel Display, which keeps every stroke flat and commanding. Noto Serif Yezidi, with a mild taper like wire rolled barely flat, packs words into solid blocks that read steadily over a longer stretch.
